headline: Paraguay Central Bank Chief Resigns Amid Ueno Bank Liquidity Crisis
summary: Paraguay's central bank president Carlos Carvallo resigned amid resolution procedures for Ueno Bank. The crisis led to the arrest of eight executives and blocked access to $380 million in savings and pension funds, triggering nationwide concern.
why: Central bank leadership changes and systemic banking crises severely impact emerging market credibility, currency stability, and foreign investor confidence in Latin America.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: A banking crisis and central bank leadership turnover threaten national financial stability and foreign investment inflows.
